subject: Preflight: credential rollout & IP safelist plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fincent.com>, Lina Gomez <lina@fincent.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight: credential rollout & IP safelist plan

Hi Samir / Lina — great demo earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get your POC trial-ready from an access and security perspective. Please confirm or correct anything below.

Summary of success criteria (from our call):
- Representative workload: ~10k utterances/day, 95th pct latency < 200ms for single-turn generation; cost target <$0.02 per 1k tokens.
- Data handling: no persistent storage of PII; all logs retained for 30 days for debug.
- Evaluation: 3 end-to-end test prompts and 2 business-critical regression prompts that you will supply.

Proposed access plan / timeline (target: start of trial next Tue):
1) SSO invites (SAML/SCIM): Redwood provides invite links + SAML metadata. We need email addresses of the users to invite and your IdP SAML metadata endpoint by EOD Thu (11/12).
2) IP safelist: Add Redwood sandbox egress IPs to your firewall. Proposed IPs: 52.23.189.10, 34.210.45.6. Please confirm if you need a CIDR block.
3) Temporary API keys: We will issue a time-limited API key (30-day expiry) for the trial sandbox; production keys can be provisioned after readiness gate.
4) Roles/owners: Fincent POC: Samir Patel (technical), Redwood POCs: Marissa Cole (CSM / deal owner), Sean Gallagher (platform ops), Vivek Kulkarni (solutions).

Attached: trial-MAP-20261110.xlsx (high-level milestones + owner map).

Ask for Fincent: can you confirm the IdP contact and the two people you want in the trial group? Also flag any procurement or procurement security questionnaire items we should expect.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internal tasks once I have your confirm.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales (Trials & POCs)
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fincent.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina@fincent.com>, Fincent Security <security@fincent.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preflight: credential rollout & IP safelist plan

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. We’re aligned on success criteria. A few clarifications and requests from our side: 

1) SSO / IdP: Our IdP Admin (Lina) will provide SAML metadata. Lina — we’ll send the list of two test users in this thread by EOD today. Our IdP domain is fincent.okta.com.

2) IP safelist / network: The security team asked whether you can provide a short-term cert or hostname instead of raw IPs; they prefer DNS allowlist where possible. If IPs are required, the two above are fine for sandbox. For production we’ll need a CIDR and SLA info.

3) API keys and rotation: Can you confirm rotation approach for the trial key? We’d like to see how to rotate without downtime and whether you support JWKS for key verification. Also what’s the typical lead time to issue keys?

4) Sandbox vs prod: We want the trial to run in an isolated sandbox with no cross-tenant data; please confirm data isolation and where logs are stored.

Finally — what’s the earliest you can provision temporary keys? If we can get keys and SSO invites this week we can start validation next Tue.

— Samir
Samir Patel
VP Engineering, Fincent
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Preflight: credential rollout & IP safelist plan

Forwarding Samir’s replies — quick internal ask: can we provision a time-limited API key and confirm sandbox isolation details for Fincent? Also, Vivek, Samir’s IdP is fincent.okta.com; Lina will send SAML metadata. Security prefers hostname over IP if possible — can we provide an FQDN or a managed hostname they can allowlist? If not, confirm CIDR for staging/prod.

Sean — can you create the temp API key (30d expiry) scoped to sandbox and include steps for rotation and JWKS details? Please add the stub key to the attachment and confirm the exact egress IPs/CIDR.

Vivek — please prepare the SSO invite flow (SAML metadata + SCIM if available) and ping me once invites are sent. Target: finish both tasks by EOD Thu so Fincent can validate next Tue.

Thanks — Marissa

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 11:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sean — can you create the temp API key (30d expiry) scoped to sandbox and include steps for rotation and JWKS details?

Done — created sandbox-scoped, time-limited API key (expires 2026-12-12). See stub below (do not use in prod):

API_KEY: redwood-sandbox-ACE-7f3b-xxxx

Rotation notes (short):
- We issue time-limited keys; to rotate without downtime create the new key via the console or API, update client to use new key, then revoke old key after verification.
- We support rotating keys via our API: POST /admin/keys (requires admin creds) and JWKS is available at https://auth.redwood.com/.well-known/jwks.json for verifying signed tokens.

Egress / allowlist: sandbox uses these static egress IPs today: 52.23.189.10, 34.210.45.6. For production we can provide a CIDR and a managed hostname (sandbox.example.redwood-inference.net is possible for staging). Please note production hostnames require SLA migration.

Attachment: api-key-stub.txt (contains the short-lived key above).

Let me know if you want me to create a second key with earlier expiry.
— Sean
